title: Chapter 243
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

Bang! Bang! Bang!

The large-caliber Berserk Eagle spewed out scorching flames, shattering all the cameras along the way. Han Xiao calculated silently. Thirty-eight seconds had passed since the alarm sounded. They were extremely fast and had already deviated from their original route. The enemy should have appeared by now.

The current team composition consisted of two burdens and two capable fighters. It was too difficult to rush out recklessly. Han Xiao had no problem himself, but protecting others was a pain in the ass. In his previous life, Han Xiao did not like to do the mission of protecting others. There was little room for him to perform, and if he was reckless, it would definitely be GG.

Han Xiao's eyes suddenly lit up, and he looked at Cyberlos with evil intentions.

With Hella, why would he need this old man? He was just a dispensable addition. Since they were not going through the underground tunnel, Cyberlos was useless.

Cyberlos trembled. "Don't — don't do anything rash. You need my authority …"

"He's exposed. My authority has been frozen. There's no point in keeping him." Hella's expression was cold. Cyberlos was the upper echelon in charge of her sister's experiment. Her hatred was deep, and she raised her hand to kill Cyberlos.

At this time, a large hand grabbed her wrist. Han Xiao shook his head at her.

"Don't kill him. He's still useful alive." Then, he slapped Cyberlos unconscious. Han Xiao had misled him so much, so it was time for him to mislead the leader.

Hella shook off Han Xiao's hand and glared at him, but she did not insist on killing Cyberlos.

Han Xiao did not mind and asked, "What's your plan?"

Hella was not used to having Zero as her teammate. Hearing this, she was silent for a while before replying, "I know a hidden passage that can escape the headquarters, but it's very far. It's four floors below us. If we want to go there, we have to break through the blockade of the headquarters."

"Four floors below us …" Han Xiao recalled the map. It would take at least five minutes to go down four floors from here. Furthermore, the enemy would not allow them to run freely.

"Is your secret passage reliable?"

"It was originally an abandoned secret passage, but I found it by chance. It's very hidden."

Hella's words were concise and comprehensive, but she did not mention the specific location.

In fact, she had hidden the truth. This secret passage was a backup plan that she had secretly prepared. Although she was controlled by the Germinal Organization, she had never given up. She had always hoped that one day, she would be able to save Aurora. However, she had always been unable to bring Aurora out of the cage, so she had never taken action. Unexpectedly, the most difficult step had been completed by Han Xiao, and this secret passage could now be put to good use. Hella could not help but feel lucky.

She didn't expect that someone would save her sister.

Hella glanced at Han Xiao discreetly. She wanted to say something but stopped on second thought.

In fact, there was a more reliable method. The chances of taking her sister away were as high as 80%, but it would put Han Xiao in danger. She felt that Han Xiao would most likely not agree, so she didn't say it out loud. She just secretly calculated in her heart.

At this time, footsteps sounded from the corner in front of them. A group of Germinal Organization soldiers appeared to intercept them.

Hila raised her hand and was about to attack, but Han Xiao beat her to it. He opened fire with both guns, and the large caliber bullets tore through the chests of these soldiers. Blood and broken bones flew everywhere, and the normal soldiers who were hit by his bullets felt like they had been hit by a grenade.

Killing a group of soldiers did not increase the Trial Points on the interface. Only enemies that were strong enough would give Trial Points. However, since the minions were here, the stronger ones were not far away.

As expected, waves of powerful auras quickly entered the range of his senses and rapidly approached him.

"Don't attack. Protect your sister. I'll take care of the enemies," Han Xiao said.

Hella frowned and said worriedly, "Can you do it? There are some executive officers that even I don't have the confidence to defeat … "

"Shut up and watch. If you didn't attack, I would have escaped." Han Xiao was not in the mood to explain to her.

Hella's expression froze. She felt that she was in the wrong and led the way in front.

The leader was on his way. The cameras were all destroyed, and the surveillance images went black one by one. He could only understand the situation through the headset.

The executive officers, super soldiers, and Inhuman teams are surrounding that area. Plus, Hella is holding Zero back. He won't be able to escape, the leader thought to himself.

At this time, an executive officer's voice came from the headset. It was murderous. "Target found. I'm going!"
